tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab 'byams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa mchog sprul thams cad mkhyen pa snyan grags lung rigs nyi ma 'jigs bral smra ba'i seṅge dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dpal kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas yan lag dang bcas pa la gsung bshad zab rgyas gnang skabs rnam bshad du mi gsal ba'i gsung rgyun khyad par can rnams brjed pas 'jigs nas go rim ma nges par ra thon lug thon gyi tshul du bri ba la/ thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs kyi dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum brjod tshe bsam bya spyi mthun no/ /skyabs yul dmigs pa rnams mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong gsung bzhin no/ /yang na mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri'i steng du pad zla so bdun gyi steng du rtsa lha so bdun gsal ba'i gtso bo'i rgyab shākya rigs dbang gi mdun du rin po che'i drwa mig gi nang du pu sti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu bsam pa'i gtso bo dang rtsa brgyud bla ma tha mi dad par bsam/ gzhan skyabs su 'gro tshul sogs spyi ltar ro/ /swa bha wa'i sngags brjod tshe rdzong lugs pa rnams thal mo khong stong gi phyag rgya byed mod/ ngor lugs la thal mo brnol ba las phyag rgya ci yang med pa paṇa chen gung rus bshad gsungs/ khro bo me ltar 'bar bas phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon bskor gyis gsor ba/ rdor sems kyis phyag g.yas pa'i thal mo gyen du bkan pa'i steng na rdo rje bsgrengs te bzung ba la thugs kar gtod de bzung ba zer/ rdor sems spyan zhi ba spyi ltar zim bu ma yin par spyan gdangs pa/ lag pa g.yas pa'i steng du hūm̐ gyen 'greng mdun rang la bstan pa'i mthar ā li g.yas bskor yig ngo nang bstan/ g.yon pa'i steng du a 'greng bu mdun rang la bstan pa'i mthar kā li g.yon bskor yig ngo phyir bstan langs thabs su yod/ g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga la rigs lnga bsgom pa zhabs rdor skyil/ dbu skra spyi bor bcing ba'i lhag ma grol ba/

zhal ras zla ba ltar zlum pa/ g.yon pa'i sor mo la yum lnga dbu skra ltag par bcing ba'i lhag ma grol ba/ zhal ras sgo nga'i dbyibs lta bu zhabs sems skyil can/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ bdag bskyed la dbang bskur ba'i skabs su spyi bor mi bskyod pa zhal shar bstan/ rigs gzhan rnams rang rang gi phyogs su zhal phyir bstan nas bzhugs/ bzlas pa'i mgo mjug gi mchod bstod ni tshe 'das kyis rang la dang / rang gi snying kha nas mchod lha spros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems kun la mchod bstod byed par bsam/ dharmā ra ṇi tshar gcig brjod tshe kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu mchod yul kun gyi spyan sngar byung bar bsam/ spyir badzra puṣpe lta bu mo rtags can la mchod pa'i lha mo spro/ puṣpaṃ sogs ma ning rtags can la thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi sne la mchod rdzas spro ba las mchod pa'i lha mo spro mi dgos/ mchod pa'i zhal zas mar me sogs rgyu bzang ba gtsang sbra che ba byed dgos/ de las bzlog na spyir nyes dmigs mtha' yas/ khyad par phyogs skyong 'byung po sogs kyi gtor ma ngan na de dag khros nas nad gdon nyer 'tshe sogs 'phral du 'byung bas shin tu gzab dgos gsungs/ mdun bskyed skabs 'byung bzhi brtsegs tshul/ rlung dkyil bu ram gor mo'i steng du rtsam pa spungs pa ltar phyogs gang nas bltas kyang gzhu gdung ba lta bu'i dbyibs yod pa/ de'i steng du me dkyil gru gsum phur gdan lta bu mgo zhabs gnyis leb mor yod pa'i zur gcig rgyab bstan dang / zur gnyis g.yas g.yon du bstan/ de'i steng du chu dkyil maṇḍal chus bkang ba lta bu/ de'i steng du sa dkyil 'bo nas kyis gang ba lta bu bsgom 'byung bzhi bsgom tshul 'di dag kun gzigs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi gsung rgyun ngo ma yin gsungs/ ri rab spyi ltar ro/ /yum bzhi las sangs rgyas spyan ma de rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug dang tha dad med pas phyag g.yas pa'i 'khor los rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i phyag mtshan dang /

'khor lo'i lte ba'i mig gis spyan ma rang gi phyag mtshan thun min bstan gsung / rdo rje bzhad pas so'i phreng ba'i sne g.yas g.yon la rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ rdo rje smra bas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i lce 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis mche ba rdo rje phyed pas yu ba byas pa gnyis 'dzin pa/ mar me dmar skyas sdong bu la me sbar ba dang bcas pa'i kong bu 'dzin pa yin gyi sdong bu kho na bzung ba go mi nyan gsungs/ mi dang 'dre gnyis mthun gcig tu gyur pa la phra men ma zer/ gro zhun ser po mon gyi skur ma la zhon pa zhes pa'i skur ni shing tog skur ba red gsungs/ spyir 'khor yug gi lha rnams kyi zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs rnams padma phrin las kyi rnam bshad du shin tu gsal/ ma lus sems can shlau ka gcig gi tshig rkang dang pos brtse ba dang tshig rkang gnyis pas nus pa dang / gsum pas mkhyen pa'i yon tan/ zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pas tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ dul zhing bsam gtan pa la bzhugs zhes pas ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ chos dang ye shes chags bral bas shes rab kyi bslab pa/ mdun bskyed la sngags rgyas dbang mi bskur na'ang dbu rgyan rang chas can nges par bsam dgos/ 'di ma byas na mdun bskyed la dbang bskur chad gsungs/ gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sngon du drug 'gyur gyi glu blangs shing zhes pa'i drug 'gyur ni/ spyir phra sbom bdeng 'jog 'gyur khrug yin kyang skabs 'dir oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa'i oṃ de oṃ drug gi yun tsam ring cha byas pas chog pa bla ma'i gsung rgyun yin gsungs/ phyi'i lha mo bzhis mchod skabs oṃ badzra sa twa pu paṃ sogs gong rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa sogs legs sbyar skad du byas pa yin/ rgyal srid sna bdun skabs dmag dpon mchod pa'i tshig rkang mtha' mar bsnyengs bral mchog ni zhes pa 'jigs pa dang bral ba la zer bas de bzhin 'don dgos/

gzhan bsnyems bral zer na nga rgyal dang bral ba la 'jug pas shin tu ma dag gsungs/ gtor ma chab kyis bran pa ni/ rgya gar na rdul che bas gtor ma la gos pa'i rdul 'khru ba'i slad du chu blugs pa'i srol yod pa de'i dod yin/ bla med la bdud rtsi sum bran byed don/ dang po bdud rtsis bgegs bsal/ chus rdul bsal/ chang gis bcud bcug pa yin gsungs/ cha gsum gyi phyogs skyong skabs/ 'di dag so sor legs par bsnams nas zer don/ phyogs skyong ba rnams sgrub mchod mthar ma phyin bar sgrub khang gi phyi rol du bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir bzhugs dgos pas der bzhugs ring bzhes phyir dang / 'byung po la 'di dag so sor legs par bzhes nas zer don gtor ma bzhes zin nas a…gyis gshegs skyems phul nas gshegs gsol byed pa'o/ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha zer don/ thog mar srin po rnams kyis brdzun kho na byas pas bden dang bral ba yin la phyis lho nub phyogs skyong gi khrims bcas nas bden pa kho na smras pas legs ldan zer gsungs/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen po klu mtha' yas/ lto 'phye klu/ grul bum 'phags skyes po'i 'khor na yod pa'i rlig pa shin tu che ba zhig yod/ nam mkha' lding bya khyung / 'dab bzang shang shang / lus srul po rgyal po pe har 'khor na yod pa shar grol skyi grol red/ dme shul lta bu la dur khrod dang / thog ma nas grub pa'i dur khrod la lhun po'i dur khrod zer gsungs/ bgegs gtor gang la'ang byin rlabs mi byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ yi ge 'bru gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon yin pas des byin rlabs byas na bgegs phal pa dkon mchog la skrag pa rnams la mi thob pa yin gsungs/ rigs drug dang yi dwags gnyis la spyan 'dren ma bshad pas mi dgos/ rang gnas su thob par bsam dgos gsungs/ gung ka re sha za'i skad red/ gdon bgegs phal cher nyin mo nyi 'od la skrag cing mtshan mo rgyu bas na gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba zer/

oṃ chen po'am 'don skabs rang khro bo me ltar 'bar ba bsgoms pa'i mig gnyis su oṃ yig 'od 'bar ba re bsgom nas sdang mig gis bdag gi bka' bzhin gzhan du mi 'gro ba'i bgegs la gzir ba'o/ /spyir kye rdor gtor ma'i skabs kyi 'byung po nyer bzhi ye shes pa la 'byung po'i ming btags pa yin/ cha gsum skabs kyi phyogs skyong 'byung po rnams 'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin pas cha gsum 'don tshe dkyil 'khor zhal khebs rgyab 'don tshar 'phral kha chus bshal dgos pa rnam bshad mang po nas gsungs pa'ang gnad kyi don te/ 'byung po dang gtam bsres pas ngag la grib phog pa bsal ba'i dgos pa yod gsungs/ ༈ /spro ba bskyed pa'i skabs grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa zhes pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di zab cing dkon pa'i grags pa mtha' yas te/ rang re rnams bde ba can du skye bar smon mod/ bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing khams du mar bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas thob pa la ches rings pa rnams snyigs dus kyi tshe lta bu dus shin tu thung ngus kyang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag tu sgrub nus pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam ci dgar nyams su blang du yod pa mi mjed 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam mdzad pa yod gsungs/ bdun brgyud rigs rnams brlag par byed/ /ces pa'i skabs su dam tshig nyams na khyim pa mi brgyud bdun tshun chad dang / dge slong yin na yang slob brgyud bdun tshun chad la gnod par 'gyur te/ dper na bla ma nus pa can zhig gis sgab 'dre mnan pas slob brgyud bdun tshun chad la phan pa dang 'dra gsungs/ mu stegs can la smad mi bya/ /zhes pa ni/ mu stegs grangs can sogs rtag lta ba bzhi la smad mi rung ste/ de dag la las 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin byed pa sogs legs pa'i cha yod pa'i phyir/ rgyang 'phen pa lta bu la smad kyang skyon ci yang med gsungs/

mkha' spyod mi 'khrugs sogs byang chog gzhan la sa bon nṛ bris na dga' ste mi yi sa bon yin pa'i phyir/ kun rig skabs gong bzhin nṛ bri ba'am ṇi bris kyang chog ste lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i ming yig yin pas sngon byung dang mthun pa'i phyir zhes mkhyen brtse rin po ches bzhed gsungs/ rnam shes dgug pa'i skabs su 'od zer dmar po spro gsungs/ rnam shes dgug skabs su ming nges par brjod dgos la rigs rus shes na'ang brjod dgos te/ sngon mo'u 'gal gyi bu lhas byin gyi ched du dmyal bar byon pa na lhas byin ces bos pas/ brgya phrag mang pos ang zer nas gang yin ma shes pas/ sangs rgyas kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi gcung lhas byin gyis gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas ngos zin pa bzhin no/ /sdig pa dor zhing dral ba'i sngags rgyas rnam shes dang sdig pa gnyis so sor phral bas/ 'og nas khrus chog byed dus sdig pa sbyong sla ba'i thabs yin te/ dper na lag pa 'dag chal gyis phur bas chu blugs ma thag dag pa bzhin no/ /bgegs bskrad skabs su rdo rje gsor bas rdo rje de las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spros/ yungs kar rnams khro bo me ltar 'bar ba bsam nas/ bgegs tshar bcad par mos/ kam̐ yig sdig pa'i sa bon yin/ de sna bug g.yas nas thon nas til la thim par bsam/ dug gsum sa yi nang du song / /zhes sogs kyi skabs su rgyu 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas 'bras bu dug gsum 'byung ba yin la/ rgyu 'byung ba bzhi yod med gang du'ang ma grub pa'i chos nyid kyi ngang du 'bras bu dug gsum thim par gyur cig zer ba'i don no gsungs/ cho ga'i mjug gi sngags rgyas dbang bskur skabs bdag bskyed dpa' bo gcig pa yin na thog mar badzra a bhi'i sngags rgya dang / bsnyen rgyas dang 'brel na buddha a bhi'i sngags rgya thog mar 'byung ngam sems gsungs/ /zhes khyab bdag 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog sprul smra ba'i nyi ma gang gis don gling 'dus grwa phal mo che la kun rig cho ga'i bshad khrid stsal skabs mgon po gang gi gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba rmongs brtul gyi na ba/
